questions.question: Abraham did not want a Canaanite wife for his son Isaac. Where did he send his servant to find one?

answers.text: To his father's house and family
To the great cities of Egypt
To the towns along the Jordan

questions.question: When Abraham's servant asked to take Rebekah to be Isaac's wife, who did her father and brother say it was from?
Rebekah's family asked if she would go with Abraham's servant to marry Isaac. What did she answer?
As Rebekah left her family to marry Isaac, they blessed her. What did they wish for her?

answers.text: To be the mother of thousands
To come back home again soon
To be rich in land and gold
